claims.text: A deep learning-based predictive model can be used to design intrinsically strong refractory high-entropy alloy compositions.
A deep learning-based predictive model can be used to design intrinsically ductile refractory high-entropy alloy compositions.
A deep learning-based predictive model can be used to design low-weight refractory high-entropy alloy compositions.
The desired properties can be achieved by optimizing the proportions of multiple principal elements.
Multi-principal-element alloys have a very large composition search space.
The proposed compositions are intended for high-temperature operating conditions.
Crystal structure and phase formation act as structural mediators between composition optimization and alloy properties.
Machine-learning algorithms and data analytics can predict an optimal RHEA composition.
The optimized composition will increase strength by 20% relative to conventional RHEA compositions.
The optimized composition will increase ductility by 15% relative to conventional RHEA compositions.
The optimized composition will decrease weight by 10% relative to conventional RHEA compositions.
Model performance is limited by the quality and quantity of training data.
Model performance is limited by complex relationships among composition, processing, and properties.
